notes: Demo config. The 'model' is a scripted deterministic agent driven through the same shell adapter a real CLI agent would use. token_budget=20000 trips the t005 treatment arm on purpose (fail-closed demo). For a real agent, point command_template at your local CLI, e.g. "your-agent-cli --workdir {workspace} --task-file {prompt_file} --skills {skill_dir}".
